description: This file implements a Flutter widget representing the 'Sign Up Credit' screen, with pixel-perfect layout, static assets, and UI components such as headers, input fields, buttons, and social icons.

classes.name: SignUpCredit081Screen

classes.name: _SocialIcon
classes.description: A small widget representing a circular social media icon with shadow effects, used within the social login row.
